units: Neh. III, 15) arms, ditches for irrigation; בית הש׳ (שדה) a field which needs irrigation, opp. בית הבעל (v. בַּעַל).
<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:1">Tosef. ib. I, 1</cite> <he>שדה בית הש׳ שחרבה</he> a field dependent on irrigation which has become dry.
M. Kat. 2ᵃ מאי משמע דהאי בית הש׳ לישנא דצחותא וכ׳ what evidence is there that beth hash-sh’laḥin has the meaning of thirstiness (dryness)? Answ. ref. to מְשַׁלְהֵי for עָיֵף (v. שַׁלְהֵי I).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:7">B. Bath. IV, 7</cite> <he>בית הש׳</he> the fields belonging to a township; expl.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 68a:10">ib. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>באגי</he> fields, <he>גינונייתא</he> gardens (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 4:13">Cant. IV, 13</cite>). Ib. 99ᵇ; a. e.
